items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free-style cleanse that won't stress skin already feeling tender along the jaw.
A light ceramide moisturizer to support the look of a comfortable, balanced skin barrier.
Daily mineral sunscreen helps keep the look of marks from darkening, which matters for deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: Big, painful lumps that leave marks are best looked at by a dermatologist, so I've held back the 5% benzoyl peroxide wash and the 30% peel, which are too strong to use on your own here; please book a visit. Until then, keep to a gentle cleanse, moisturizer and sunscreen each morning, and avoid scrubbing or picking.
